1. Communication process:
   · How do you keep owners updated (portal, app, reports)?
   · Frequency of financial statements and owner reports
   · Preferred contact method for urgent issues
4. Your process if my apartment is put up for sale while tenanted:
   · How do you handle viewings with existing tenants (notice period, coordination)
   · How is the rental income and security deposit transferred to a new owner
   · Timeline and legal steps if the new owner requests vacant possession

Please also let me know if you have a standard service agreement I can review.

Thank you, and I look forward to your proposal.
